# commander_manage_company (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a managed company by name or ID. Returns the company's ID, name, node, base plan, and file storage plan so you can reference them in other resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `managed_company` (String) Managed Company Name or ID to find the company.

### Read-Only

- `file_plan` (String) File storage plan of the found managed company.
- `id` (String) ID of the found managed company.
- `name` (String) Name of the found managed company.
- `node` (String) Node of the found managed company.
- `plan` (String) Base plan of the found managed company.
